description: Check whether a domain or link is the official address of a crypto exchange, wallet or dApp — Korean exchanges (Upbit, Bithumb, Coinone, GOPAX, DigitalX/Korbit) and major global exchanges, wallets and dApps — compared with the addresses the companies publish themselves (the Korean exchanges' council member list, app store developer websites, verified GitHub organisations). Verdicts: official, danger (not official and the phishing check found impersonation evidence), not_official (uses a name but is not an official address — the name alone is not impersonation), not_exchange. A domain that uses a name also gets its registration date, the first certificate DechoNet saw for it, and a phishing check of its front page (which may render it). Read-only; no API key; rate-limited.

domain.description: Domain or link to check (e.g. 'upbit-event.example' or 'https://…')

name: crypto_exchange_check

actions.description: Recommended next actions, most important first

grade.description: Letter grade (A+ to F) when the tool grades the target

observation.description: How much was actually observed and when. A partial observation means some checks did not answer: missing parts are not verified, never clean.

receipts.description: Signed observation receipts behind this result, one per lookup: when, from where and under which rules version DechoNet observed it. Each url shows the record and checks its Ed25519 signature.

reportUrl.description: Human-facing interactive report for this exact lookup on dechonet.com

score.description: 0-100 score when the tool scores the target
